name: qa-team-management
description: QA people-and-org toolkit for QA managers and heads of quality: 5 skills (skill-matrix-author, career-ladder-author, tester-one-on-one-planner, performance-feedback-author, exec-quality-narrative) and 1 agent (team-capability-gap-analyst).
